_about: Bundled PCB review checklist of altium-copilot (run_review_checklist). Item texts are this project's own words; the topics follow Altium's PCB design review checklists (resources.altium.com/p/pcb-design-and-review-checklist, resources.altium.com/p/pcb-design-review-checklist-gets-you-manufacturing-quickly). Teams change it with review_checklists.json (see README).
title: PCB layout review
description: Placement, power and thermal, high speed and constraints, manufacturing, testability.
source: Topics after Altium's PCB design review checklists (resources.altium.com/p/pcb-design-and-review-checklist and /p/pcb-design-review-checklist-gets-you-manufacturing-quickly); items written for this project.

items.text: The board matches the schematic: no missing or extra parts, and no footprint, comment or pad-net differences.

judge.label: compared with a netlist older than some sheets

items.hint: Altium's Show Differences is the final word; with netlist_stale, refresh the netlist first.

items.text: Placed footprints match their library footprints (no unintended edits on the board).

no.label: footprints that differ from the library

judge.label: footprint differences shown as info
no footprint could be compared with its library

items.hint: A difference does not say which side is right: ask before suggesting Update From PCB Libraries.

items.text: Decoupling capacitors sit close to the supply pins they serve, with a short path to them.

no.label: capacitors far from their IC or on the other side without a via

judge.label: placement notes

items.text: ESD and TVS parts sit at the connector they protect, before the trace reaches the IC.

no.label: protection parts far from their connector

judge.label: protection placement notes

items.text: Parts keep enough spacing from each other and from the board edge for assembly and rework.

judge.label: spacing measured without an assembler limit

items.hint: Ask the assembler for its spacing and edge limits (check_dfm limits=).

items.text: The board has a closed outline and the mounting holes the mechanics need.

na.label: outline and mounting hole gates not applicable

no.label: outline or mounting hole gate failed

judge.label: outline or mounting hole gate warned or not verified

yes.label: outline and mounting hole gates passed

items.text: Connectors, switches, LEDs and mounting holes line up with the enclosure, and tall parts clear it.
Polarity, pin-1 marks and designators stay readable on the silkscreen once the board is assembled.
Exposed pads and tabs of hot parts have thermal vias into a plane or pour.

no.label: thermal pads without vias or on the wrong net

judge.label: thermal pad notes

items.text: Hot parts are spaced apart and kept away from electrolytics, crystals, references and sensors.

judge.label: hot part neighbourhood notes

items.text: Copper of high-voltage nets keeps the spacing its working voltage needs (IPC-2221B or the product's standard).

na.label: no net pair differs by more than the voltage threshold

no.label: spacings below the standard or rule

judge.label: spacing notes and nets of unknown voltage

items.hint: Ask the working voltages (check_hv_clearance hv=); creepage around slots is not computed.

items.text: Traces, pours and vias that carry high current are sized for it, and its return path is short and unbroken.
Every net is fully routed: no connection is missing.

judge.label: nets joined only through assumed plane or pour copper

items.text: Polygons are poured and saved: none is shelved or changed since its last repour.

judge.label: polygon gate warned or not verified

items.text: No isolated copper islands or long dead-end stubs (antennae) are left on the board.

judge.label: isolated copper islands
antennae over their tolerance

items.text: Tracks and vias meet their width, via, hole, annular-ring and routing-layer rules.
Length and matched-length rules are met.

no.label: length rules with violations beyond the measuring tolerance

judge.label: length rules with marginal violations only
length rules with members not fully routed

items.hint: Marginal violations are within measuring tolerance of the limit: confirm them with Altium's DRC.

items.text: Differential pairs are declared, not swapped at their pins, and within their skew tolerance.

judge.label: pair notes (stale or conditional rules, marginal skew)

items.text: Altium's last Batch DRC report is clean and newer than the board.

judge.label: DRC gate warned or not verified

items.text: Impedance-controlled nets have a stack-up impedance profile and rules that use it.
items.hint: constraints_review audits each interface's rules against its layout guide.

items.text: Fast signals keep a continuous reference plane, avoid plane splits and change layers next to a return via.

na.label: no fast net found (differential pairs, high-speed classes, rule scopes, clock or bus names)

no.label: fast nets over splits or voids, layers without a reference plane, or reference net changes without a capacitor

judge.label: return-path notes (plane edges, single anti-pads, layer changes without a stitching via)

items.hint: check_return_path picks the fast nets by reason: confirm them, or name others with net= or net_class=. Places marked likely rest on approximated copper.

items.text: Clocks, switch nodes and other noisy nets are kept away from sensitive analog and high-speed nets.
items.hint: get_net_neighbors shows what runs near a net.

items.text: Copper, holes and the board outline meet the chosen fabricator's limits.

no.label: misses of the chosen fabricator's limits

judge.label: fabrication misses and warnings
checked against Altimade's limits by default, not the user's fabricator

items.hint: Ask which fabricator builds the board and use its limits (fab_profile.json or check_dfm limits=).

items.text: Via aspect ratios, annular rings, tenting and vias in pads are what the fabricator expects.

judge.label: via notes (via in pad, tenting, stubs)

items.text: The PCB health check is clean: no shelved polygons, duplicate designators, zero-area or self-intersecting shapes.

judge.label: health warnings

items.text: Each assembled side has global fiducials.

judge.label: fiducial gate warned or not verified

items.text: Small passives are not prone to tombstoning, and fine-pitch parts are within the assembler's capability.

judge.label: tombstoning and pitch notes

items.text: Silkscreen keeps clear of pads and solder-mask openings.

judge.label: silkscreen gate warned or not verified

items.text: The pick-and-place origin and part centroids are what the assembler expects.

judge.label: pick-and-place notes

items.text: Nets the test plan needs have probe access.

judge.label: coverage notes

items.hint: The numbers are guidance: ask the test house for its own (check_testpoints limits=).

items.text: Test points meet the probe size, spacing, edge clearance and component clearance of the fixture.

no.label: test points that break a fixture rule

judge.label: test point notes

items.text: Rails and ground have enough probe sites, and the board has tooling holes for a fixture.

no.label: rails, ground or tooling holes short of the guidance

judge.label: rail, ground and tooling notes

items.text: The test strategy (in-circuit, flying probe, boundary scan, functional) is agreed with the test engineer.
